description: Land Acquisition - Moraliya, Ruwanwella D/S Division, Kegalle District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice under the Land Acquisition Act, declaring that specific parcels of land are needed for a public purpose. It describes the exact location, boundaries, and extent of the land lots to be acquired in detail. The content is exclusively about land acquisition matters, falling squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) which covers "land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" and "any gazette content primarily dealing with land, property, or real estate matters."
